name: 28081 · Kannapolis, NC
findings: ZIP 28081 (Kannapolis) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28081 (Kannapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28081 (Kannapolis) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
